experiment_title: INTELISE Component 4 — Phase 3C.1A AI Contribution Ablation

findings_summary.binary_detection_ceiling_effect: Both DETERMINISTIC_ONLY and LLM_ASSISTED achieved Binary F1 = 1.000. Because real test failures and AST static security scans deterministically identify 100% of seeded defects, the LLM provides zero delta on binary detection. This ceiling effect is explicitly reported.
findings_summary.primary_llm_value_add: LLM reasoning significantly improves defect localization on assertion-only failures where pytest tracebacks do not contain solution line numbers, and elevates repair-feedback usefulness from symptom reporting (mean 2.81/5) to actionable fix guidance (mean 4.63/5).

reproducibility.reconciliation_rule: Deterministic AST and test outcomes strictly take precedence over model hypotheses.
